title: A nice Modpack
description: This mod pack is Mainly focused on performince and Looks
body:
**WARNING:** If your PC cannot run shaders, please do not use this modpack.

This modpack focuses on aesthetics. I have also included additional features such as guns and waypoints. I have also added simple voice chat, the mod do a barrel roll and tom's simple storage mod. In future versions, I may add more mods, such as Create or Clockwork. I have already incorporated some performance mods to enhance your experience.
(Do not mind the name of the modpack when downloaded thsi was my personal modpack and i just uploaded it)
